description: Retrieve details about Python applications installed in isolated virtualenvs using pipx.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Path to the pipx installed in the system. If not specified, the module uses python -m pipx to run the tool, using the same Python interpreter as ansible itself.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: The module passes the --global argument to pipx, to execute actions in global scope. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: include_deps
parameters.description: Include dependent packages in the output. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: include_injected
parameters.description: Include injected packages in the output. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: include_raw
parameters.description: Returns the raw output of pipx list --json. The raw output is not affected by include_deps or include_injected. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of an application installed with pipx.

examples:
- name: retrieve all installed applications
  community.general.pipx_info: {}

- name: retrieve all installed applications, include dependencies and injected packages
  community.general.pipx_info:
    include_deps: true
    include_injected: true

- name: retrieve application tox
  community.general.pipx_info:
    name: tox
    include_deps: true

- name: retrieve application ansible-lint, include dependencies
  community.general.pipx_info:
    name: ansible-lint
    include_deps: true

return_values.name: application
return_values.description: The list of installed applications. Returned: success

return_values.name: dependencies
return_values.description: The dependencies of the installed application, when include_deps=true. Returned: success Sample: ["virtualenv"]

return_values.name: injected
return_values.description: The injected packages for the installed application, when include_injected=true. Returned: success Sample: {"licenses": "0.6.1"}

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the installed application. Returned: success Sample: "tox"

return_values.name: pinned
return_values.description: Whether the installed application is pinned or not. When using pipx<=1.6.0, this returns null. Returned: success Sample: {"pinned": true}

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: The version of the installed application. Returned: success Sample: "3.24.0"

return_values.name: cmd
return_values.description: Command executed to obtain the list of installed applications. Returned: success Sample: ["/usr/bin/python3.10", "-m", "pipx", "list", "--include-injected", "--json"]

return_values.name: raw_output
return_values.description: The raw output of the pipx list command, when include_raw=true. Used for debugging. Returned: success
